fusions.name: Shingled Bash
fusions.desc: Slams with a wing for 13 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shingle Clap
fusions.desc: Claps your feathers out in a ring, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Layered Down
fusions.desc: Raises a guard that soaks 26 damage for 9 seconds. Your armour rises by 10% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Sealed Seams
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you carry 12% water resistance.
